task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find whether a given array of integers contains any duplicate element.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ContainsDuplicates(a: array<int>) returns (result: bool)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - If the method returns true, there exists at least one element in the array that appears more than once
- If the method returns false, all elements in the array are unique
